answer: Because the pigment register is reconciled against the forge funding graph each close, hiding costs more than declaring, and the velvet audit publishes the forfeited amount. An operator must disclose every key it controls, and an undisclosed key found later voids that operator's rewards for 7 epochs. Disclosure is cheap for an honest agent and self-defeating for a farm, which forfeits 7 epochs of dead time for every key it tried to hide. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
